contact.basis: Fixed externalvalleyground beside mainarchcentre before independent512mfield/geometry, not bridge-deckelevation or surveyedfooting.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole GraftonBridge frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.4m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Coarse urban composite may not resolve bridge footing contacts, bridge-deck returns or valley cuts; exact construction-grade classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
